## Story

<div class="reader-page">

<div class="reader-text">

</div>

## Think About It

1. What is the goat's name? (Greta.) 2. Why does Greta not play with others at first? (She is shy.) 3. How does Greta help the toad? (She carries it out of the mud on her back.)
